name: Perspective Correct Splat Rasterization with EWA Approximation
aliases: Perspective Accurate Splatting with EWA Filter
definition: An improved splat rendering pipeline based on a perspectively correct fast splat rasterization procedure enhanced by an approximation of the EWA filter.
summary: Perspective Correct Splat Rasterization with EWA Approximation is a fast splat rendering method that uses an affine approximation to projective mapping to ensure perspective-correct splat shapes without per-point normals, solving aliasing and visual holes.
